company_name.description: The full legal name of the company presenting

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, including the exchange if stated, e.g. 'NYSE American: PRK'

fiscal_period.description: The fiscal period the presentation covers, e.g. 'Q4 2025'

as_of_date.description: The as-of date for the financial figures, as YYYY-MM-DD

headquarters.description: City and state of the company headquarters

total_assets.description: Total assets as stated, including units, e.g. '$9.8 billion'

business_description.description: One sentence describing what the company does

installment_lending.description: The installment lending portfolio broken down by credit tier

indirect_loans.description: Value of indirect installment loans as stated, including units, e.g. '$1.6B'

direct_loans.description: Value of direct installment loans as stated, including units, e.g. '$186MM'

weighted_average_fico.description: Weighted average FICO credit score of the installment portfolio, as stated

portfolio_by_credit_tier.description: Share of the installment loan portfolio held by each credit tier, from the pie chart

fico_range.description: FICO score range for this tier, e.g. '780+' or '740 - 779'

share_of_portfolio_percent.description: Percentage of the portfolio in this tier as a number, e.g. 52.35

balances_by_origination_year.description: Installment loan balances by credit tier and origination year, in thousands of dollars, from the table beneath the bar chart
